plugins.name: diffmode-growth-tactics
plugins.description: Diffmode free growth-ideation pipeline: a /run-growth-tactics orchestrator + diagnostics intake, enrichment, think-tank research, a per-run clean-room LIGHT vector DB, lite synthesis constraints, and a 2-stage synthesis (explore → build) that stops at 7-9 novel demand-gen tactic ideas. Parameterized reviewer + worker sub-agents. Self-contained: writes runs into ./<slug>/ in the user's cwd, no host repo required.
